cards.ex: The Amazon is facing alarming deforestation rates due to illegal logging.
cards.exUz: Amazonka noqonuniy daraxt kesish tufayli dahshatli o'rmon kesish sur'atlari bilan yuzlashmoqda.
cards.uzDef: O'rmonlarning kesilish tezligi, qanchalik tez o'rmonlar yo'qolayotgani.

cards.ex: Alaska offers some of the last pristine wilderness areas in North America.
cards.exUz: Alyaska Shimoliy Amerikadagi oxirgi buzilmagan yovvoyi tabiat hududlarini taklif qiladi.
cards.uzDef: Inson ta'siridan butunlay saqlangan, tabiiy va beg'ubor joy.

cards.ex: Reforestation plays a crucial role in carbon sequestration and mitigating climate change.
cards.exUz: O'rmonlarni qayta tiklash uglerod sekvestratsiyasida va iqlim o'zgarishini yumshatishda muhim rol o'ynaydi.
cards.uzDef: O'simliklar va tuproq tomonidan atmosferadan uglerod yutilishi jarayoni.

cards.ex: Habitat destruction is the primary driver of threatened species worldwide.
cards.exUz: Yashash joylarining yo'q qilinishi butun dunyo bo'ylab yo'qolib borayotgan turlarning asosiy sababidir.
cards.uzDef: Yo'q bo'lib ketish xavfi ostida bo'lgan o'simlik va hayvon turlari.

cards.ex: Increased funding is vital for effective conservation efforts in the region.
cards.exUz: Mintaqada samarali tabiatni muhofaza qilish harakatlari uchun moliyalashtirishni ko'paytirish juda muhimdir.
cards.uzDef: Tabiatni saqlash va tiklashga qaratilgan har qanday chora-tadbirlar.

cards.ex: If we fail to address climate change, the dire consequences will be irreversible.
cards.exUz: Agar biz iqlim o'zgarishiga e'tibor bermasak, og'ir oqibatlar qaytarilmas bo'ladi.
cards.uzDef: Juda jiddiy va yomon natijalar.

cards.ex: Farmers are adopting sustainable practices to minimize their environmental footprint.
cards.exUz: Fermerlar atrof-muhitga ta'sirini kamaytirish uchun barqaror amaliyotlarni qo'llamoqdalar.
cards.uzDef: Tabiiy resurslarni saqlashga qaratilgan usullar va harakatlar.

cards.ex: We need to raise awareness about the importance of protecting our oceans.
cards.exUz: Okeanlarimizni muhofaza qilish muhimligi haqida xabardorlikni oshirishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Odamlarning biror muammo haqidagi bilimini va tushunchasini oshirish.

cards.ex: The burning of fossil fuels is a major contributor to air pollution.
cards.exUz: Qazilma yoqilg'ilarning yoqilishi havo ifloslanishiga katta hissa qo'shadi.
cards.uzDef: Ko'mir, neft va tabiiy gaz kabi er ostidan qazib olinadigan yoqilg'i turlari.

cards.ex: Reducing greenhouse gases is crucial to preventing further global warming.
cards.exUz: Issiqxona gazlarini kamaytirish global isishning oldini olish uchun juda muhimdir.
cards.uzDef: Atmosferada issiqlikni ushlab turadigan gazlar, masalan, karbonat angidrid.

cards.ex: We need more people on the ground to monitor wildlife populations.
cards.exUz: Yovvoyi hayvonlar populyatsiyasini kuzatish uchun joyida ko'proq odamlar kerak.
cards.uzDef: Vaziyatning markazida, amalda.

cards.ex: The coral reefs are experiencing a devastating die-off event due to rising sea temperatures.
cards.exUz: Marjon riflari dengiz haroratining ko'tarilishi sababli halokatli o'lish hodisasini boshdan kechirmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Bir turdagi organizmlarning katta miqdorda birdaniga o'lishi.

cards.ex: Climate change is exacerbating food scarcity in many regions of the world.
cards.exUz: Iqlim o'zgarishi dunyoning ko'p hududlarida oziq-ovqat tanqisligini kuchaytirmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Oziq-ovqat yetishmasligi, oziq-ovqat mahsulotlarining yetarli emasligi.

cards.ex: We may have already passed the tipping point for some ecosystems.
cards.exUz: Biz allaqachon ba'zi ekotizimlar uchun burilish nuqtasidan o'tgan bo'lishimiz mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Qaytarib bo'lmaydigan o'zgarishlarga olib keladigan kritik vaziyat.

cards.ex: Glaciers are melting at an alarming rate due to global warming.
cards.exUz: Global isish tufayli muzliklar xavotirli tezlikda erimoqda.
cards.uzDef: Juda tez va xavfli darajada.

cards.ex: Habitat restoration is essential for the recovery of many endangered species.
cards.exUz: Yashash joyini tiklash ko'plab yo'qolib borayotgan turlarning tiklanishi uchun zarurdir.
cards.uzDef: Buzilgan yoki yo'qolgan yashash joylarini qayta tiklash jarayoni.

cards.ex: Human activities are disrupting the natural balance of many ecosystems.
cards.exUz: Inson faoliyati ko'plab ekotizimlarning tabiiy muvozanatini buzmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Ekotizimdagi o'zaro bog'liqlik va barqarorlik.

cards.ex: Sustainable forestry practices ensure the long-term health of our forests.
cards.exUz: Barqaror o'rmon xo'jaligi amaliyotlari o'rmonlarimizning uzoq muddatli sog'lig'ini ta'minlaydi.
cards.uzDef: O'rmonlardan resurslarni kelajak avlodlar uchun saqlab qoladigan usulda foydalanish.

cards.ex: Investing in clean energy sources is essential for a sustainable future.
cards.exUz: Toza energiya manbalariga sarmoya kiritish barqaror kelajak uchun zarurdir.
cards.uzDef: Atrof-muhitga zarar keltirmaydigan energiya manbalari, masalan, quyosh va shamol energiyasi.

cards.ex: We need to consider the bigger picture when making decisions about conservation.
cards.exUz: Tabiatni muhofaza qilish bo'yicha qarorlar qabul qilishda kattaroq manzarani ko'rib chiqishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Vaziyatning umumiy, kengroq nuqtai nazari.

cards.ex: The loss of a keystone species can have a devastating knock-on effect on the entire ecosystem.
cards.exUz: Asosiy turning yo'qolishi butun ekotizimga halokatli zanjir ta'sirini ko'rsatishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Bitta hodisa boshqa bir qator hodisalarga olib keladigan ta'sir.

cards.ex: Wildlife conservation is a pressing issue that demands immediate attention.
cards.exUz: Yovvoyi tabiatni muhofaza qilish tezda e'tibor qaratishni talab qiladigan dolzarb masala.
cards.uzDef: Tezda hal qilinishi kerak bo'lgan muhim muammo.

cards.ex: Many animal populations are under severe pressure due to habitat loss and hunting.
cards.exUz: Ko'plab hayvonlar populyatsiyasi yashash joylarini yo'qotish va ov qilish tufayli qattiq bosim ostida.
cards.uzDef: Juda katta qiyinchiliklar va tahdidlar ostida bo'lish.

cards.ex: Industrial pollution is a major cause of environmental degradation.
cards.exUz: Sanoat ifloslanishi atrof-muhitning buzilishining asosiy sababidir.
cards.uzDef: Atrof-muhitning sifati yomonlashishi, zararlanishi.

cards.ex: Deforestation is occurring on a massive scale in the Amazon rainforest.
cards.exUz: Amazon o'rmonlarida o'rmon kesish keng miqyosda sodir bo'lmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Juda katta hajmdagi yoki miqdordagi narsa.

cards.ex: Planting trees can help offset the damage caused by deforestation.
cards.exUz: Daraxt ekish o'rmon kesish natijasida yetkazilgan zararni qoplashga yordam berishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Salbiy ta'sirni kamaytirish yoki yo'q qilish uchun choralar ko'rish.

cards.ex: Overfishing can deplete fish stocks and disrupt marine ecosystems.
cards.exUz: Haddan tashqari baliq ovlash baliq zaxiralarini kamaytirishi va dengiz ekotizimlarini buzishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Resurslarni ishlatib tugatish, kamaytirib yuborish.

cards.ex: If we invest in conservation now, future generations will reap the benefits.
cards.exUz: Agar biz hozir tabiatni muhofaza qilishga sarmoya kiritsak, kelajak avlodlar foydasini ko'radilar.
cards.uzDef: Qilingan ishning ijobiy natijalarini olish.

cards.ex: Forest management aims to achieve a sustainable yield of timber.
cards.exUz: O'rmon xo'jaligi yog'ochni barqaror hosildorlik bilan ta'minlashga qaratilgan.
cards.uzDef: Resurslarni shunday ishlatishki, ular tugamasdan doimiy ravishda mavjud bo'ladi.

cards.ex: We need to find ways to live in harmony with nature.
cards.exUz: Tabiat bilan uyg'unlikda yashash yo'llarini topishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Bilan muvofiq holda, birgalikda.
